primitives.name: Defensive Completion Suppression
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'def_completions_allowed': 'dimensionless count of passes completed against', 'def_completion_pct': 'dimensionless ratio of completions to targets'}
primitives.assumptions: Player performance is independent of team context; linear relationship between targets and completions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-target scenarios where completion rate exceeds baseline by 20%+.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies defensive efficacy in limiting passing plays through completion suppression.
layer2.telemetry: Completion percentage relative to expected baseline per game.

primitives.name: Pressure Generation Efficiency
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'def_pressures': 'dimensionless count of quarterback pressures generated', 'def_sacks': 'dimensionless count of sacks recorded', 'def_times_hurried': 'dimensionless count of hurries'}
primitives.assumptions: Each pressure event contributes equally to overall defensive disruption.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Low-pressure environments where individual events dominate outcome variance.

layer2.mapping: Maps defensive pressure events to quarterback decision-making delay and error probability.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of total pressures to opponent's pass attempts per game.

primitives.name: Tackle Efficiency Index
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'def_tackles_combined': 'dimensionless total tackles made', 'def_missed_tackles': 'dimensionless count of missed tackles', 'def_missed_tackle_pct': 'dimensionless ratio of misses to attempts'}
primitives.assumptions: Missed tackles are uniformly distributed across game time and space.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-tackle volume games where accuracy drops below 90% threshold.

layer2.mapping: Measures defensive reliability in stopping running plays and maintaining gap integrity.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage reduction in missed tackles compared to league average.

reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a triadic system capturing defensive behavior: suppression of completions via coverage discipline, generation of pressure through pass rush, and maintenance of run defense through tackling. These operators exhibit duality in that high completion suppression correlates with low pressure generation due to reduced target volume, while tackle efficiency inversely affects both. Failure modes include over-reliance on one metric leading to vulnerability in others—e.g., aggressive pressuring without adequate coverage can result in big plays. The system operates under conditional independence assumptions but shows strong interdependence in practice. Each primitive maps to distinct game states: pre-snap preparation, snap-to-snap execution, and post-play recovery.
